title: Planned film tests of telepathy and of communication over the Hill
summary: Ky Dickens tells of Planned film tests of telepathy and of communication over the Hill, about planned, 2025 onward at unspecified, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: be having two or three uh non-speakers in different locations to communicate together um via the hill

plain: A documentary maker named Ky Dickens, who made a film series called The Telepathy Tapes about children said to read minds, says that from 2025 she planned filmed tests with a researcher, Diane Powell. According to Dickens, the plan was to put two or three non-speaking people in different places and have them talk to each other through "the Hill", which she describes as a shared meeting place in the mind. If it worked as she hopes, it would suggest that people can communicate by thought alone.
